summary: Zeo ScientifiX filed a Form 8-K to report a press release announcing that it had trained over 500 clinicians through its monthly Masterclass series in regenerative biologics. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action. It is a routine operational update regarding the company's educational program milestone. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
